sample_unit: survey responses from medical imaging and radiotherapy professionals

links.outcome: Association between prior AI training and knowledge of AI tools and frameworks
links.effect: Prior training was strongly correlated with increased knowledge about AI tools and frameworks; knowledge of related frameworks remained low overall.
links.quote: Prior training was strongly correlated with increased knowledge about AI tools and frameworks.

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of UK medical imaging and radiotherapy practitioners exploring governance, training, and clinical adoption of AI tools.
